# [TASK] Pin real SHA256 checksums for the two Vosk archives #212 introduced

## Task
#212 added two Vosk models: English `vosk-model-en-us-0.22-lgraph` and German
`vosk-model-small-de-0.15`. Its environment could not reach
`alphacephei.com`, so it pinned all-zero placeholder SHA256 values for both
archives in `infrastructure/scripts/download-vosk-model.sh` and
`backend/ai-service/Dockerfile`. `sha256sum -c` failed on every real
download. This Task replaces the placeholders with the real hashes.

## Scope
The four hash values, and the comment and error text that called them
placeholders.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [x] `MODEL_SHA256[en]` in `infrastructure/scripts/download-vosk-model.sh` is the SHA256 of `vosk-model-en-us-0.22-lgraph.zip` (`curl -fsSL https://alphacephei.com/vosk/models/vosk-model-en-us-0.22-lgraph.zip | sha256sum` prints the pinned value)
- [x] `MODEL_SHA256[de]` in the same script is the SHA256 of `vosk-model-small-de-0.15.zip` (`curl -fsSL https://alphacephei.com/vosk/models/vosk-model-small-de-0.15.zip | sha256sum` prints the pinned value)
- [x] `VOSK_MODEL_SHA256` and `VOSK_MODEL_SHA256_DE` in `backend/ai-service/Dockerfile` equal the two script values (`grep -E '^ARG VOSK_MODEL_SHA256' backend/ai-service/Dockerfile` and `grep -E '^\s+\[(en|de)\]="[0-9a-f]{64}"' infrastructure/scripts/download-vosk-model.sh` print the same two hashes)
- [x] The script downloads, verifies and unzips both archives (`infrastructure/scripts/download-vosk-model.sh` against an empty `infrastructure/docker/models/` exits 0 and creates both model folders)

## Estimate
**Hours:** 0.5

## Notes
Closed against commit `78c3803`.

Vosk publishes no checksums. The pins record what `alphacephei.com` served on 2026-09-20. Both archives are old (English last modified 2021-11-23, German 2020-12-03), so a later mismatch means the upstream file changed and needs a look before the pin is updated.
